notes.title: Updates Updates Updates!
notes.content:
-Adjustment to Manny/Nosey hold points and consistency
-Several under-the-hood changes to input systems are being made in preparation for mixing ProtoFreerunning with ProtoSports (BMX Streets). If all is well, nothing should be noticeable in ProtoSports.
-Flip INPUT did not have the same "weight" as the spinning. These now are the same. Flipping should feel a smidge more "Heavy"
